newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM SAYS PLANS TO SELL FRENCH PAPER MILL.
newsitem.headline: UPM SAYS PLANS TO SELL FRENCH PAPER MILL.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said in a statement on Thursday it planned to sell one of its two Chapelle Darblay paper mills in France.
UPM said it intended to sell the St.Etienne du Rouvray magazine paper mill to French corrugated board producer Otar.
"The transaction will improve the cash flow of the magazine paper division. The write-off on the transaction will be approximately 800 million markka," UPM said.
The St.Etienne mill has an annual output capacity of 220,000 tonnes of coated magazine paper and annual turnover of 770 million markka.
"The competitiveness of the mill's two LWC (light-weight coated paper) machines has been outrivalled by modern magazine paper machines," UPM said.
Otar, the second largest maker of corrugated board in France, plans to have the St.Etienne mill start making light testliner and fluting from January 1998, UPM said.
"Even after the transfer, UPM-Kymmene will continue to be the world's leading LWC manufacturer with an annual capacity of two million tonnes," it said.
UPM-Kymmene is Europe's biggest forest industry group.
